final: WITH event_ratios AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(1.0 * spent / amount) AS spend_ratio FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM event_ratios) SELECT er.link_to_event AS event_id, er.spend_ratio, er.spend_ratio / o.avg_ratio AS relative_spend_ratio FROM event_ratios er CROSS JOIN overall o ORDER BY relative_spend_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
